result.summary: The eleventh trigger search was performed over a scope explicitly disjoint from rounds seven through ten: algebraic coding theory (Reed-Solomon/BCH syndrome decoding, error-locator polynomial constructions -- Berlekamp-Massey, the Euclidean-algorithm decoder, Peterson-Gorenstein-Zierler) and sparse polynomial / exponential-sum reconstruction (Ben-Or/Tiwari, Prony's method and modern variants), via the arXiv export API, which answered every query directly (no rate-limiting observed). Component (a) retrieved syndrome/key-equation decoders and Groebner-basis reformulations (Bras-Amoros & O'Sullivan; Augot, Bardet & Faugere; Shany & Berman; Chang, Lee & Feng; Peterson-Gorenstein-Zierler literature) and established, from the sources' own abstracts, that 'the syndrome' in every construction is defined as a function of the received (possibly corrupted) word -- an already witness-bearing object -- and that even granting a public analogue, the direction these algorithms make cheap (public syndrome to unknown error-locator roots) is the reverse of the P1553 need (known g_I roots to public residual r_R mod g_I), which collapses the matching direction to the already-costed ROUTE-04 multipoint evaluation. Component (b) retrieved sparse-interpolation and Prony-method reconstruction theory and established that it requires both an a priori sparsity bound (absent for r_R under the frozen premises) and a black-box evaluation oracle whose per-query cost equals ROUTE-04's materialization cost; the nearest coding-theoretic/elliptic-curve intersection found (Elliptic Curve FFT, arXiv:2107.08473) is a fast-arithmetic accelerant for that same already-costed route, not a new identity. Two internal-corpus off-target items (Wiedemann/Block-Wiedemann sparse linear algebra; LFSR annihilator attacks; a McEliece Berlekamp-Massey side-channel attack) were considered and declined as wrong-problem/wrong-domain. A lossy-projection-test audit independently shows the natural syndrome-analogue tracked object for component (a) is in exact Chinese-Remainder-Theorem bijection with r_R mod g_I -- a change of coordinates, not a lossy projection -- and the sparse-interpolation tracked object for component (b) is genuinely lossy but has no established compatible propagation rule or sparsity bound. The resource-check answer is examined true, none found, for both components. Every candidate considered (C1-C5) is judged item-by-item against the frozen gate (G1-G8); none passes every item. The honest disposition is scoped_no_candidate.
result.preserved_scope: No B71 admission, experiment, evidence, ECDLP attack, speedup, novelty, closure, SOTA movement, or breakthrough is claimed. The coordinate-aware P1553 target-local remainder transducer and the exact dyadic subinterval unit-product interface remain open under their exact narrow boundaries, as does every broader preserved route, including algebraic coding theory and sparse-interpolation constructions with a genuinely public (not received/corrupted-word-derived) syndrome-analogue or an established a priori sparsity bound and a sub-ROUTE-04-cost evaluation oracle (as an open resource beyond the specific formulations searched this round, not as an admitted trigger). Round ten's closed deck-local mixed-radix/CRT sub-avenue over the two named P1553 mixed-radix packets was not reopened; no candidate this round touches that geometry. Pollard rho remains the realized frontier.
